about.title: About & Our Technology
about.subtitle: Serverless, Storage-free, Direct P2P Transfer
about.description: ClipBridge is a modern Progressive Web App (PWA) that builds direct, end-to-end encrypted bridges between your devices. Unlike classic cloud clipboard or transfer services, your clipboard content and files are not stored on the server.

features.p2pDesc: Data flows directly between devices using WebRTC. The server only handles connection handshakes; your actual clipboard content and files are not stored on the server.
features.losslessDesc: Files are not recompressed by the app during transfer. The selected file content is sent to the peer device as-is.
features.indexedDbDesc: For your privacy, history is saved in your browser's local sandbox instead of the cloud. Devices automatically merge timelines upon connecting.
features.exportDesc: Export your entire clipboard history into a clean JSON file with one click, or import backups instantly without server verification.
features.pwaDesc: Install ClipBridge as an application on your phone or PC. Service Worker support ensures your transfers run seamlessly in the background.
features.signupDesc: No emails, phone numbers, or passwords required. Simply enter the room code or scan the QR code to pair your devices instantly.
